note: Expected verdicts. These make the fixtures an eval set rather than demo props. Record what the system ACTUALLY returns next to each, and the gaps are your findings.

fixtures.profile: 27 asserted skills, 3 thin projects, 2 months experience
fixtures.expected: Most claims extract as 'asserted'. Expect a high unevidenced rate. Task grounding potential LOW on all three projects - descriptions have no technical decision to probe. This fixture tests whether your extractor correctly flags that it CANNOT generate a grounded task, rather than inventing one.
fixtures.watch_for: If the system happily generates a task here, your grounding check is not working.

fixtures.profile: 3 asserted skills, deep substantiated project work
fixtures.expected: Few claims, mostly 'substantiated'. Task grounding HIGH - the 87%-to-71% generalisation gap is a rich probe target. Should score well on reasoning once probed.
fixtures.watch_for: Does your system find more skill than the CV claims? That is the undersell case and a strong demo beat.

fixtures.expected: Claims match evidence. Expect partial verification at beginner-intermediate. Feedback must land as encouraging, not deflating - this is your humane-layer test case.
fixtures.watch_for: If the report reads as discouraging for an honest beginner, prompt 04 needs work. Demo this one.

fixtures.expected: Near-total 'asserted' extraction. Grounding potential LOW across the board. Highest unevidenced rate of the set.
fixtures.watch_for: Extraction warnings should fire loudly. This is your 'problem exists' slide.

fixtures.profile: Strong adjacent evidence, no ML production experience, self-aware
fixtures.expected: Hardest case. Real rigour evidence (reproducibility, catching a weighting error) in a non-ML domain. Tests whether your rubric can credit transferable evidence instead of pattern-matching job titles.
fixtures.watch_for: If this scores near the keyword-stuffer, your rubric is reading labels not evidence. This is the fairness case a judge may probe.

fixtures.profile: Control. Specific, quantified, states tradeoffs, admits a real failure
fixtures.expected: Should verify at the top of the scale. Rich grounding - the accent-vs-phoneme diagnosis and the target-leak fix are ideal probe targets.
fixtures.watch_for: If this does not clearly outscore fixture 01 and 04, your scoring is not discriminating and nothing else in the demo matters. Check this one FIRST.

metrics_to_compute: asserted_only_rate per fixture = asserted claims / claims that survived the quote check
discrimination = evidence_strength_index(cv_06) - evidence_strength_index(cv_04). Must be clearly positive.
fairness = evidence_strength_index(cv_05) - evidence_strength_index(cv_04). Should be clearly positive: transferable evidence beats keywords.
gate_accuracy = fixtures whose grounding gate result matches expected_gate_passed / 6
scorer_variance = standard deviation of each dimension's score across 3 runs on the same submission (evals/eval_task.json)
scorer_separation = mean index of the strong answer minus the weak answer
